name: Centrist reformism
notAnIdeology: Wikipedia's article is a short South Korean (Jungdogaehyeokjuui) entry that lists parties that used the label and says it resembles conservative liberalism, but it describes no positions on any policy area. The party articles and news coverage opened (People Party 2016, Korea Times on the Bareun Mirae Party) give only vague self-descriptions such as 'future-oriented and reformative', so no reliable source documents what its adherents hold and the label works as a party positioning term.

sources.title: New centrist party vows to beat two major parties - The Korea Times
